Destination pages

The new destination page is live for all seven destinations. Same order and same parts everywhere; only the facts and the trips change. Trips come back all the way down the page, next to the part they belong to. Open the links on a phone or in a narrow window.

What is on the page

Top to bottom, on Bali

1. Photos, title, vibes

Swipe the photos; white dots show there are more. Name, Google rating, three lines of intro with Read more, then the vibes, each opening the gallery at its photo.

See on Bali

2. Flights and visa, side by side

Hours and the direct cities, the visa and how long you can stay. The detail lives in Getting there.

See on Bali

3. Most loved trips

The first trip row, straight after the facts, for people already planning.

See on Bali

4. Best time to visit

An accordion of seasons, the first open. Each header in its season's colour, the months on the right, one weather tag and the temperature inside.

See on Bali

5. Things to do, then Trips with an activity

Big photo cards with a heart. The trip row under it ends in the activity; tap it to pick another and the trips change.

See on Bali

6. Places, then Trips with a place

A real map with a pin per area and area cards. The trip row under it ends in the place, changeable the same way.

See on Bali

7. Getting there, then Recently booked trips

Pick your city for the flight, then airports, visa and money. Then the trips other travellers booked.

See on Bali

8. Sunday School, then Relaxed trips

The live video rail, then slower trips.

See on Bali

9. Compare, then Trips under a budget

Two similar places side by side. Then trips under a budget set for each country.

See on Bali

10. Questions and Traveller Reviews, last

Five questions answered for the destination, then the home page's reviews block.

See on Bali

Section bar

Once the top is behind you, a bar of section chips pins to the top, the section you are in lit, a pink line for how far down you are. The same bar as the itinerary page.

See on Bali

See all

Every trip row has See all on the right; it opens the whole list.

See on Bali
Where it comes from

Real data, and what is still a sample

  • From the app: seasons and weather, areas and the map, things to do, every trip in the rows, Sunday School videos, saves.
  • Trip rows are picked from what each country's trips include, and only show with two trips or more. The activity and place lists only offer what at least two trips include.
  • Written for this page, as of November 2026: intros, flights by city, airports, visa, currency and rates, the questions.
  • Samples: six Bali trips with the Gili Islands or an ATV ride, ratings and review text, Liked and Didn't like, booking names and times.

To check

  1. Visa and flight lines for each destination, checked by the team. Thailand's rule changed in September.
  2. Replace the six sample Bali trips with real ones, or keep them.
  3. Real Google reviews and real Liked and Didn't like for each destination.
  4. Maldives and Mauritius booked-trip cards have no trip page yet, so they reopen the destination.

The earlier layouts stay on their own links for reference.
